entries.name: Hero Eyebrow Label
entries.semantic_description: Small uppercase eyebrow label positioned above hero headline. Used for product category, release badge, or marketing callout. Creates visual hierarchy and draws attention to the main headline. Common in SaaS and product landing pages.
entries.css: .hero-eyebrow { display:inline-block; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:#f97316; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; margin-bottom:8px; }

entries.name: Hero CTA Button Group
entries.semantic_description: Paired CTA buttons for hero sections with primary and secondary actions. Primary button uses solid fill, secondary uses outline or ghost style. Horizontal layout with wrapping on mobile. Standard pattern for conversion-focused hero areas.
entries.css: .hero-cta-group { display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; }

entries.name: Pricing Popular Badge
entries.semantic_description: Prominent badge overlay for highlighting recommended pricing tier. Positioned at top of pricing card with contrasting color. Text reads Most Popular or Recommended. Drives conversion by guiding user choice in multi-tier pricing layouts.
entries.css: .popular-badge { position:absolute; top:-12px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); background:#f97316; color:#fff; padding:4px 16px; border-radius:20px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; }

entries.name: Pricing Feature List with Checkmarks
entries.semantic_description: Vertical list of pricing features with green checkmark icons. Each item shows included capability or benefit. Clean typography with adequate spacing. Standard pattern for communicating plan value in pricing tables and comparison grids.
entries.css: .feature-list { list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; } .feature-list li { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; } .check-icon { color:#22c55e; flex-shrink:0; }

entries.name: Dashboard KPI Stat Card
entries.semantic_description: Compact stat card for dashboard metrics showing label, large number value, and trend indicator. Used in analytics dashboards and admin panels. Displays key performance indicators with up/down arrows and percentage change. Essential for data visualization contexts.
entries.payload: article stat-card bg-white border rounded-xl p-6
entries.css: .stat-card { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:12px; padding:24px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; } .stat-label { font-size:13px; color:#6b7280; font-weight:500; } .stat-value { font-size:32px; font-weight:700; color:#111827; } .stat-trend { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; } .trend-up { color:#22c55e; } .trend-down { color:#ef4444; }

entries.name: Dashboard Sparkline Mini Chart
entries.semantic_description: Small inline line chart showing trend over time. Minimalist design without axes or labels. Used alongside KPI cards to provide visual context for metric changes. SVG-based for crisp rendering at any size.
entries.css: .sparkline { width:100%; height:40px; } .sparkline path { fill:none; stroke:#6366f1; stroke-width:2; }

entries.name: Product Card with Image and Price
entries.semantic_description: E-commerce product card with image area, category label, title, star rating, price, and add-to-cart button. Standard online store pattern. Hover state elevates card with shadow. Optimized for product listing and catalog grid layouts.
entries.payload: article product-card bg-white border rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-lg
